stocks.title: Oil above 100 and a tech dump close out a brutal week
stocks.detail: Brent near 110 and WTI over 100 on Hormuz risk. Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5% on the week, its worst since April 2025, with the 10-year yield at 5.10% and semis down eight straight days.

stocks.title: Nvidia in correction, valuation at multiyear lows
stocks.detail: NVDA is down about 11.9% over eight sessions, with forward P/E at levels not seen since 2016. Traders debate buying the dip versus a deeper AI unwind, with 212 as the support level.

stocks.title: Huang tells investors the AI rout will pass
stocks.detail: Speaking to Bloomberg in Berlin, Jensen Huang said AI is just beginning and urged focus on long-term fundamentals as chip stocks slide on borrowing costs.

stocks.title: Monster earnings week next: Netflix, Tesla, Meta
stocks.detail: Over 200 companies report Oct 19-23. Netflix Tuesday, Tesla, Meta and IBM Wednesday, P&G Thursday. Traders are already lining up options plays on TSLA.

tech.title: Bank of America says the AI boom mirrors past busts
tech.detail: Hyperscaler capex forecasts jumped from 330 billion to 1 trillion, about 3% of US GDP, while AI token prices halved since summer. BofA compares it to the railroad and dot-com eras.

tech.title: Taiwan moves to criminalize AI chip exports to China
tech.detail: Part of the US-Taiwan trade deal: unauthorized AI server and advanced chip exports to China would become a crime. China proposed export controls on 40 technologies of its own.

tech.title: Elorian launches Glimpse visual reasoning model
tech.detail: The Palo Alto startup with ex-DeepMind and Apple talent opened a research preview, claiming stronger chart and video reasoning than rivals.

tech.title: Terence Tao warns of an AI industrial age in math
tech.detail: After a flood of AI-generated math papers, Tao said volume is crowding out insight and could hit junior researchers hard.

world.title: Pentagon to hold Minab school strike report until after midterms
world.detail: The near-complete review reportedly cites flawed intelligence, outdated imagery and AI overreliance. Rep. Jason Crow and others are demanding immediate release.

world.title: Norte Fire forces evacuations near San Clemente
world.detail: The Orange County fire grew past 250 acres under Santa Ana winds, with homes burned and orders in San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano zones.

world.title: Iran puts its military on 72-hour high alert
world.detail: Reports describe air defenses, missiles and armor moving near the Iraqi border. Israel raised its own alert; no confirmed attack plans so far.

world.title: Iran vows to push US Navy ships farther from its coast
world.detail: Tehran says it will force US warships beyond 500 km and reports tanker incidents near Hormuz. CENTCOM says commercial ships still pass.
